name: spot_walk
title: Spot walk (residual PPO on a model-based trot; velocity-conditioned)
summary: Boston Dynamics Spot walks straight and durably (+119 m / 298 s) via residual PPO on a model-based trot, with a velocity-conditioned variant for walk/stop cycles and a terrain-curriculum variant that clears 18 cm rubble. The OmniSim-native RL pipeline's first robot. Same quadruped .npz ghost lineage as go2_walk.

ghost.notes: The spot walk ghost is a foot-sphere-on-calf trot retarget. Other spot ghosts (getup/hill/jump/crouch) are stored .npz under research/shadowing/ghosts/.

baton.notes: Cross-robot cataloguing; not blended with the g1 family.

train.notes: OmniSim-native residual PPO on a model-based gait. See docs/developer/spot-residual-rl.md.

deploy.notes: Controller + policy baked into the world; `skill_lib.py run spot_walk` launches it.

verification.result: Spot walks +119 m / 298 s straight, 0 falls; terrain variant clears 18 cm rubble (memory project_spot_walk_g1_recipe / project_quad_terrain_training_works).
